company_lookup.source_excerpt: # RGL Logistics RGL Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RGL Logistics is a full-warehousing, distribution, and transportation management company. RGL Logistics employs 235 people (+4.4% YoY, +10 people) and has an annual revenue of $2.2M, founded in 1903. Headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States, with offices in Appleton and Neenah. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, Ghana, and Rwanda. ## About Logistics is changing. We’re changing logistics. Today simplicity, speed, and waste reduction reign supreme – and logistics managers are on the hot seat to deliver results that improve the company’s bottom line. But the market today isn’t moving fast enough to deliver what companies need. Instead, most supply chain managers struggle with the resulting complexity and rising costs. We take a wholly different approach to managing your supply chain that we call WHAT IF Logistics. We work with people at innovative, on the move firms who are tired of the way traditional logistics is handled. We take what you’re doing today and ask WHAT IF, looking for what can be made better, more streamlined, more efficient. ## Company Details - Industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage - Type: Privately held - Headquarters: Green Bay, United States - Founded Year: 1903 - Homepage: rgllogistics.com - Aliases: rgl logistics, rgl the what if logistics company - LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/rgl-holdings - Linkedin
